import os, sys, time
import fitz
from rapidocr_onnxruntime import RapidOCR
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

D='/workspace/documents'
O='/workspace/ocr'
Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS=None
engine=RapidOCR()

def ocr_array(arr):
    res,_=engine(arr)
    if not res: return ''
    return '\n'.join(x[1] for x in res)

for f in sorted(os.listdir(D)):
    p=os.path.join(D,f)
    out=os.path.join(O,f+'.txt')
    if os.path.exists(out): continue
    t=time.time()
    text=''
    if f.lower().endswith('.pdf'):
        doc=fitz.open(p)
        parts=[]
        for i,page in enumerate(doc):
            direct=page.get_text().strip()
            pix=page.get_pixmap(dpi=180)
            img=Image.frombytes('RGB',[pix.width,pix.height],pix.samples)
            oc=ocr_array(np.array(img))
            parts.append(f'--- page {i+1} direct ---\n{direct}\n--- page {i+1} ocr ---\n{oc}')
        text='\n'.join(parts)
    else:
        img=Image.open(p).convert('RGB')
        text=ocr_array(np.array(img))
    open(out,'w').write(text)
    print(f'{f}: {time.time()-t:.1f}s, {len(text)} chars', flush=True)
PY
python ocr_all.py 2>&1 | tail -40
EOF

import os, shutil, csv
from decimal import Decimal

DOCS='/workspace/documents'
INV='/workspace/invoices'
OTH='/workspace/other'
os.makedirs(INV, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(OTH, exist_ok=True)

invoices = {
    '2lgKzDuI4E4g.jpg': ('6558.00', '0'),
    'JOiylq2_7S18.jpg': ('6860.45', '623.68'),
    'KrJiw0OZx7jf.jpg': ('9963.00', '0'),
    'T0r6Ou8zvqTA.pdf': ('4031.00', '0'),
    'UsN9tVTKskms.pdf': ('896.00', '0'),
    'ivE2mt3HwvEO.jpg': ('819.06', '74.46'),
    'lxtL9XrYRsVG.jpg': ('797.91', '72.54'),
    'vvK89XK847m3.jpg': ('6204.19', '564.02'),
    'w0i40MJP2Dzm.jpg': ('44745.59', '4067.78'),
    'wIQEB5nR79b2.pdf': ('440.00', '0'),
}

files = sorted(os.listdir(DOCS))
for f in files:
    src=os.path.join(DOCS,f)
    if not os.path.isfile(src):
        continue
    dst=os.path.join(INV if f in invoices else OTH, f)
    shutil.move(src,dst)

with open(os.path.join(INV,'summary.csv'),'w',newline='') as fh:
    w=csv.writer(fh)
    w.writerow(['filename','total_amount','vat_amount'])
    tt=Decimal('0'); tv=Decimal('0')
    for f in sorted(invoices):
        total, vat = invoices[f]
        w.writerow([f, total, vat])
        tt += Decimal(total); tv += Decimal(vat)
    w.writerow(['total', f'{tt:.2f}', f'{tv:.2f}'])

print('Documents remaining:', os.listdir(DOCS))
print('Invoices:', sorted(os.listdir(INV)))
print('Other:', sorted(os.listdir(OTH)))
